seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms, pools meager funds for gear, and takes odd courier jobs — stumbling into a conspiracy involving Ugathul infiltrators posing as Blackline cops, Embercall Inc., and illegal radar dishes. The arc ends with a break-in at a Gryphonline mail office to crack a suspicious P.O. Box.

seasons.title: The Consultant's Descent
seasons.arc_summary: Signed on as Magical Crimes Convox consultants, the party sabotages a radar dish, descends into the Widdershins sewers to find a slaughtered resistance, and discovers Master Grayson's necromantic Victorian manor inside a Fane deep underground. The arc culminates in a catastrophic ambush at the Crowded Flea that leaves three party members dead.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: After the total party kill, Johnny and Benny navigate the void between life and death, meet the entity Aut, and return to the mortal world — losing Argyle permanently but gaining the sentient polar bear paladin Sir Arctos. The reformed party takes brutal revenge on Hlarf and Tywelwyn Leatherhide, uncovering a network of six alien gods attempting to crack the firmament via radar dishes.

seasons.title: The Keystone Hunt
seasons.arc_summary: Reporting their findings to the Inquisition and surviving an undead ambush at Brooks' apartment, the party rescues Anaïs and learns of the cosmic Narrative — five sibling entities including their patron Aut. They then embark on a pilgrimage scavenger hunt, trading a stolen Kellan Quinn painting for a keystone and weathering Argyle's unsettling partial resurrection.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: During a six-month downtime, the party investigates the royal sewers beneath Hallia and discovers a hairline fracture in reality — a parallel world where a two-mile-tall imprisoned god looms behind the firmament. After hacking a terminal to uncover a vast conspiracy funded by Grayson and the Prime Minister, they bomb the Teller's Run research facility and flee through a collapsing underground.

seasons.title: The Strider
seasons.arc_summary: The party joins the pilgrimage aboard a colossal walking Strider city, creates their own heart named Eerie, and navigates deadly faction politics under a devil Master of Ceremonies who demands a weekly tithe of magical energy. They form alliances with neighboring organizations, absorb weaker factions' hearts, and begin exploring the dangerous spider-infested Undercroft beneath the Strider.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Quorum Descent
seasons.arc_summary: Scale operatives are dispatched to a shattered Joker World to investigate a mysterious slip-shielded structure. After battling through demonic swarms, they breach the fiend-built Quorum, solve its puzzles, descend through a bloodfall portal, and fight a desperate defense to free Voice of Many — a trapped divine entity and child of Sigzil — before teleporting to safety. (Episode 1 opens with the unrelated conclusion of the Cagley Middle shadow-demon one-shot before this arc begins.)

seasons.title: The Husk Murders
seasons.arc_summary: Convox detectives Cedric, Krod, and Mickey (later Andros) travel to Wrenford to investigate 48 husk-murders linked to a mysterious fey stone necklace, venturing into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse where they battle fey creatures and uncover the Gloaming Codex — a book that pulls them into its pages.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: Three Sedecium agents — Scrazzy, Foral, and Ozzie — investigate an unpowered orbital station half-sunken in the slip, free a tortured ship AI, and uncover that the Thessian Esoterica recently accessed observatory records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job: Stealing from a Dead God
seasons.arc_summary: The fire team is pulled from retirement for a desperate raid on the divine essence of the freshly-killed Thessian god Tithe, navigating slip-puzzles and spider temples to plant a beacon before the God Eater Harrow devours everything — becoming the only fire team to succeed.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
